# MG — Maximum Growth

MG is a boutique web and SEO agency founded by Mustapha Bourigue in Béni Mellal, Morocco.
MG designs custom, fast, mobile-first websites and improves Google visibility for schools, medical practices, real estate agencies, beauty businesses, restaurants, hotels and professional services.
Mustapha Bourigue has more than three years of experience in web development and SEO.
Services include custom websites, technical and local SEO, performance optimisation, WhatsApp and booking integrations, online payment integration and practical AI automation.
A standard 5 to 6 page business website is generally delivered in 2 to 4 weeks.
Contact: +212 699 309 986 on WhatsApp or bouriguemustapha0@gmail.com.
Location: Béni Mellal, Morocco.
French is the default language; English content is available under /en.
